unavailable_fields.communication.nccl_algorithm_protocol_ch: Not applicable: single-device task. observations.json capability 'communication' is not_applicable with reason 'single-device task' and request.json has distributed_backend null, so nccl_tuning has no actual NCCL decisions to capture; kernel entry names alone do not identify protocol.
unavailable_fields.communication.per_collective_pcie_nvlink: No distributed communication exists to measure. device_telemetry reads device-wide NVML PCIe rates/utilization/memory with native windows only, not per-collective bytes, and PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be invented from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.communication.synthetic_allreduce_refere: Not applicable: single-process workload with no allreduce. collective_calibration would measure an unrelated synthetic collective that is neither a performance lower bound nor a critical-path estimate for this forward pass.
unavailable_fields.communication.gradient_bucket_membership: Not applicable: inference-only workload under inference_mode; no gradient buckets, no communication hook, distributed_backend null. Exact bucket links would require native correlation and observed gradient-storage membership, none of which exist here.
unavailable_fields.numerical.per_site_error_first_divergenc: No actual collector compares intermediate tensors, measures per-site numerical error, or locates the first numerical divergence; candidate_diagnostics records only exceptions and False returns. Not currently needed: quality passed with exact top1 and logits within atol/rtol 1e-4.
unavailable_fields.candidate_path.successful_path_proof: candidate_diagnostics does not record normal calls or non-False scalar returns, so an empty event stream cannot establish which successful path executed. Route corroboration must rely on execution_timeline trace evidence plus coverage counters (candidate_invocations 2 and 4, framework_fallbacks 0) from evaluation.json.
unavailable_fields.host.clean_dispatch_gpu_separation: python_runtime is the only host-side collector and its warmed cProfile perturbs execution; its inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations, so a clean host-vs-GPU split is unavailable from any collector. No host-dispatch uncertainty is observed anyway (single GPU forward; 7894.5/7673.5 img/s vs 7120.3 floor).
unavailable_fields.binding.per_group_overhead: binding_cost reports whole-invocation cost in clean AB/BA workers and omits candidate build/computation; per-group binding effects are unavailable from any collector. Whole-invocation overhead was measurable but not requested: throughput under the installed additive bundles already passes the floor with about 10.9 percent headroom, and it would not resolve the memory attribution uncertainty.

rationale: Frozen objective is peak_allocated_bytes on the single-device offline batch-32 ResNet-18 forward (measurement lifetime invocation; distributed_backend null; observations.json marks communication not_applicable, 'single-device task'). The accepted candidate 87fa652a68fd3bfac113272179f28133f5ffc6c881e6b026c6289012f6d4d474 measures 155229184 B against paired parent 204905472 B (original reference 281975808 B) with images_per_second 7894.5/7673.5 above the 7120.3 floor and quality pass, so the decision-relevant uncertainty is: (a) which allocations and regions compose the invocation peak and where region kernel time is spent, to judge whether further chunked composite bundles (e.g. later stages or downsample paths) fit within the throughput floor; and (b) evaluation.json's explicit caveat that the declared routes (chunked_stem_composite, chunked_stage0_composite, chunked_stage1_composite) are candidate-reported telemetry. Coverage shows framework_fallbacks 0 and the earlier torch run associated 103/103 kernels with 0 unassociated and 0 ambiguous sequences, but reference_invocations (32 and 240) may implement fallback, verification or composition and must not be assumed to be fallback. Selection: torch re-selected with only memory- and region-scoped fields, since its prior run produced association counters, not allocation attribution, and peak_allocated_bytes is a torch-allocator quantity only this collector can decompose; candidate_diagnostics for actual handled-exception (with library traceback locations) and False-return evidence inside the candidate files on the worker thread, which is the only real fallback signal (absence of events does not prove the successful path); execution_timeline for an independent plain trace with per-device intervals, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations and synchronization events to corroborate route execution and region boundaries. Exclusions: nsys is available but not selected because attribution is already complete and no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution question is observed. nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and device_telemetry are not applicable to a single-process single-device workload, and device-wide NVML windows do not attribute allocator bytes. python_runtime perturbs execution and yields no clean GPU timing. binding_cost is eligible (both bundles are additive; effective direct binding with reason 'no functional replacements' is recorded, which does not imply zero overhead) but is not selected because throughput under the installed bindings already passes the floor with margin and whole-invocation cost would not resolve the memory attribution uncertainty; it can run in subsequent candidate resource feedback if binding overhead becomes decision-relevant.
